questions.source_content:
ADMINISTRATIVE CIRCULAR
Municipal Corporation Administrative Wing, Bharatpur
Date: 15 May 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/222)
Subject: Quarterly Inspection of Departmental Vehicle Logbooks and Fuel Consumption Registers (Phase-3)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Bharatpur division are hereby informed that under 'Quarterly Inspection of Departmental Vehicle Logbooks and Fuel Consumption Registers', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 20 May in the central portal wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #322) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Bharatpur, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and portal movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Bharatpur), 2. Budget Reconciliation #132, 3. Digital Indexing.
District Supply Officer
Vikas Kumar Pareek
solution_steps: 2. Click Bold, Underline, and Font Size '20'.
